// n8n Code 节点：Run Once for All Items。
// 只筛选搜索候选；不代表客户已核实或已匹配。
let config = {};
try { config = $('配置搜索目标').first().json || {}; } catch (_) {}
const MAX = 1;
const known = $('整理已知域名').first().json;
if (known.existing_customers_checked !== true || !Array.isArray(known.known_domains)) throw new Error('已有客户检查未完成，停止筛选');
const knownDomains = new Set(known.known_domains);
const skippedExisting = [];
const includeSocial = config.include_social !== false && config.include_social !== 'false';

const inputs = $input.all().map((item, index) => ({
  data: item.json?.body ?? item.json ?? {}, index,
}));
const hits = inputs.flatMap(({ data, index }) =>
  Array.isArray(data.results)
    ? data.results.map(result => ({ result, index }))
    : data.url ? [{ result: data, index }] : []
);
if (!hits.length) {
  return [{ json: { found: false, stage: 'search', reason: '没有收到搜索结果，请检查 Tavily Search 输出。' } }];
}

const socialDomains = ['facebook.com', 'instagram.com', 'linkedin.com', 'youtube.com', 'youtu.be', 'tiktok.com', 'twitter.com', 'x.com', 'pinterest.com', 'reddit.com', 'quora.com'];
const blockedDomains = ['wikipedia.org', 'abc.net.au', 'smh.com.au', 'news.com.au', 'dailytelegraph.com.au', 'theguardian.com', '9news.com.au', '7news.com.au', 'medium.com', 'alibaba.com', 'made-in-china.com'];
const blockedBrands = ['seek', 'indeed', 'jora', 'glassdoor', 'careerone', 'adzuna', 'jobsora', 'jooble', 'talent', 'careerjet', 'simplyhired', 'ziprecruiter', 'workforceaustralia', 'hipages', 'oneflare', 'yellowpages', 'truelocal', 'localsearch', 'hotfrog', 'yelp', 'houzz', 'gumtree', 'airtasker', 'serviceseeking', 'startlocal', 'aussieweb', 'dlook', 'brownbook', 'boombusinessdirectory', 'cylex', 'yably', 'bark', 'google', 'bing', 'amazon', 'ebay'];
const belongs = (host, domain) => host === domain || host.endsWith('.' + domain);
const seen = new Set();
const selected = [];

for (const { result: r, index } of hits) {
  if (!r || typeof r.url !== 'string') continue;
  const url = r.url.trim();
  const m = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^\/?#:]+)(?::\d+)?([^?#]*)(\?[^#]*)?(?:#.*)?$/i);
  if (!m) continue;
  const host = m[1].toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, '');
  const path = m[2] || '/';
  if (host === 'localhost' || !host.includes('.') || /^\d+(\.\d+){3}$/.test(host)) continue;
  const platform = socialDomains.find(domain => belongs(host, domain));
  if (platform && !includeSocial) continue;

  if (platform) {
    // 保留具体公开主页、帖子、群组等；排除平台首页、登录与搜索页。
    if (path === '/' || /^\/(login|signin|signup|accounts|checkpoint|search|explore|feed|home)(\/|$|\.)/i.test(path)) continue;
    if (platform === 'linkedin.com' && /^\/jobs(\/|$)/i.test(path)) continue;
  } else {
    if (blockedDomains.some(domain => belongs(host, domain))) continue;
    if (host.split('.').some(label => blockedBrands.includes(label))) continue;
    if (/directory|findglocal|word-of-mouth|superpages/i.test(host)) continue;
    if (/\/(jobs?|careers?|vacanc[^/]*|employment|news|wiki|directory|listings?)(\/|$)/i.test(path)) continue;
  }

  // 社媒按具体页面去重；网站按域名去重。
  // 保留 Facebook profile.php?id=...、YouTube watch?v=... 等身份参数。
  const params = (m[3] || '').replace(/^\?/, '').split('&').filter(Boolean)
    .filter(p => !/^(utm_[^=]*|fbclid|gclid|msclkid)=/i.test(p)).sort();
  const pageKey = platform + path.replace(/\/+$/, '') + (params.length ? '?' + params.join('&') : '');
  const key = platform ? 'social:' + pageKey : 'website:' + host;
  if (knownDomains.has(host)) {
    skippedExisting.push({domain:host,url});
    continue;
  }
  if (seen.has(key)) continue;
  seen.add(key);
  selected.push({
    json: {
      found: true,
      source_url: url,
      source_title: r.title || '',
      search_snippet: r.content || '',
      source_kind: platform ? 'public_social' : 'website',
      source_platform: platform || host,
      candidate_key: key,
      verification_status: '待核实',
      selection_reason: '飞书中尚无此域名，优先调查新公司',
      skipped_existing_count: skippedExisting.length,
      skipped_existing: skippedExisting,
      known_domain_count: knownDomains.size,
    },
    pairedItem: { item: index },
  });
  if (selected.length >= MAX) break;
}

return selected.length ? selected : [{ json: {
  found: false, stage: 'select',
  reason: skippedExisting.length ? '本次搜索中通过筛选的候选均已在飞书收录，已跳过；未调用正文提取和Dify。可更换搜索词或地区继续发现新公司。' : '没有筛选出可研究的具体网页；已排除招聘、新闻、目录及平台通用页面。',
  skipped_existing_count: skippedExisting.length,
  skipped_existing: skippedExisting,
  known_domain_count: knownDomains.size,
  checked_urls: hits.map(({ result }) => result?.url).filter(Boolean),
} }];
